under_posters.title.description: Settings > Libraries row and page title: the setting for what shows under the focused poster. Row label, short.

under_posters.detail.value: Choose what appears under posters, for movies and TV shows alike.
under_posters.detail.description: Detail line under the Under posters row on the Settings root. One short sentence naming the kinds it applies to: movies and TV shows.

under_posters.copy.value: Most posters already show their title. Choose what appears under them, for movies and TV shows alike. The preview uses the library you last opened.
under_posters.copy.description: Narrative copy beside the Under posters page: what the setting does, which kinds it covers, and where the preview's posters come from. Three short sentences.

under_posters.title_row.description: Switch row label on the Under posters page: show the item title under the focused poster.

under_posters.title_detail.value: Shows each title under its poster.
under_posters.title_detail.description: Detail line under the Title switch on the Under posters page: what the Title switch shows.

under_posters.none.description: Under posters details choice (first in the list): show no details line. A single word that reads as 'show nothing'.

under_posters.reset.description: Button on the Under posters page that restores the default (no title, year and length, sort value on).

under_posters.reset_detail.value: Puts Title, Movie details, TV show details and Sort value back to their defaults.
under_posters.reset_detail.description: Detail line under Reset to default on the Under posters page: what the default shows (year and length, sort value on, no title).

under_posters.sample_title.description: Placeholder title of the sample poster in the Under posters preview. One short word that fits inside a small poster tile, e.g. Movie.

under_posters.sample_genre.description: Sample genre shown in the Under posters preview, one word.

under_posters.sort_value.description: Switch on the Under posters page: while a library grid is sorted by something other than Title or Random, show the value it is sorted by on one line under every card (the movies, TV shows, seasons and episodes of a library). Default on, per profile. Short noun phrase.

under_posters.sort_value_detail.value: Replaces the details line while a library is sorted.
under_posters.sort_value_detail.description: Detail line under the Sort value switch: the value line replaces the details line while the library is sorted.

under_posters.value_today.description: Sort value in a library grid sorted by a date (Date added, Date viewed, release date): the date is today. One short word.

under_posters.value_yesterday.description: Sort value in a library grid sorted by a date (Date added, Date viewed, release date): the date is yesterday. One short word.

under_posters.value_never.description: Sort value in a library grid sorted by Date viewed or Plays, under an item that was never played. Shown quietly (50% white), the same word for both sorts. One short word.

under_posters.value_plays.description: Sort value in a library grid sorted by Plays: how many times the item was played, always with its noun ("14 plays", "1 play"). The number and the noun are joined by a no-break space. Short: it must fit under a 250 px poster.

under_posters.movie_details_row.description: Row label on the Under posters page that opens the Movie details picker, and that picker's page title. Its right side reads the chosen line, e.g. Year · Length. Short.

under_posters.show_details_row.description: Row label on the Under posters page that opens the TV show details picker, and that picker's page title. Its right side reads the chosen line, e.g. Year · Seasons. Short; 'TV show' is the same word the app uses for a series elsewhere.

under_posters.movie_details_detail.value: Choose what appears under movie posters.
under_posters.movie_details_detail.description: Sentence beside the Movie details row on the Under posters page while it has focus (rows have no sub-line). Up to four details can be ticked: year, length, genre, video quality, age rating, score.

under_posters.show_details_detail.value: Choose what appears under TV show posters.
under_posters.show_details_detail.description: Sentence beside the TV show details row while it has focus. Up to four details can be ticked: year, seasons, genre, age rating, score (a show has no video quality).

under_posters.part_year.description: Under posters picker row and details-row name: the release year. One short word.

under_posters.part_length.description: Under posters picker row and details-row name: the running time of a movie. One short word.

under_posters.part_seasons.description: Under posters picker row and details-row name: how many seasons a TV show has. One short word.

under_posters.part_genre.description: Under posters picker row and details-row name: the genre. One short word.

under_posters.part_video.description: Under posters picker row and details-row name: video quality marks such as 4K · HDR. Short.

under_posters.part_age_rating.description: Under posters picker row and details-row name: the age rating, e.g. PG-13. Short.

under_posters.part_score.description: Under posters picker row and details-row name: the audience score, e.g. 7.8. One short word.

under_posters.details_count.description: Details row value on the Under posters page when four details are ticked and the names would not fit: the number of ticked details with its noun ("4 details"). Short.

under_posters.blocked_year.value: Up to four details fit under a poster. Remove one to add the year.
under_posters.blocked_year.description: Sentence beside a picker row that cannot be ticked because four details are already ticked (the row is disabled): say that four is the most and which part to remove first, ending with the part named in the accusative or object form. One full sentence per part so each language can decline the part name. Part: year.

under_posters.blocked_length.value: Up to four details fit under a poster. Remove one to add the length.
under_posters.blocked_length.description: Sentence beside a picker row that cannot be ticked because four details are already ticked (the row is disabled): say that four is the most and which part to remove first, ending with the part named in the accusative or object form. One full sentence per part so each language can decline the part name. Part: length.

under_posters.blocked_seasons.value: Up to four details fit under a poster. Remove one to add the seasons.
under_posters.blocked_seasons.description: Sentence beside a picker row that cannot be ticked because four details are already ticked (the row is disabled): say that four is the most and which part to remove first, ending with the part named in the accusative or object form. One full sentence per part so each language can decline the part name. Part: seasons.

under_posters.blocked_genre.value: Up to four details fit under a poster. Remove one to add the genre.
under_posters.blocked_genre.description: Sentence beside a picker row that cannot be ticked because four details are already ticked (the row is disabled): say that four is the most and which part to remove first, ending with the part named in the accusative or object form. One full sentence per part so each language can decline the part name. Part: genre.

under_posters.blocked_video.value: Up to four details fit under a poster. Remove one to add the video quality.
under_posters.blocked_video.description: Sentence beside a picker row that cannot be ticked because four details are already ticked (the row is disabled): say that four is the most and which part to remove first, ending with the part named in the accusative or object form. One full sentence per part so each language can decline the part name. Part: video.

under_posters.blocked_age_rating.value: Up to four details fit under a poster. Remove one to add the age rating.
under_posters.blocked_age_rating.description: Sentence beside a picker row that cannot be ticked because four details are already ticked (the row is disabled): say that four is the most and which part to remove first, ending with the part named in the accusative or object form. One full sentence per part so each language can decline the part name. Part: age rating.

under_posters.blocked_score.value: Up to four details fit under a poster. Remove one to add the score.
under_posters.blocked_score.description: Sentence beside a picker row that cannot be ticked because four details are already ticked (the row is disabled): say that four is the most and which part to remove first, ending with the part named in the accusative or object form. One full sentence per part so each language can decline the part name. Part: score.

under_posters.sentence_year_movie.description: Sentence beside the Year row of the Movie details picker while it has focus: what the part shows, with the real example from the preview poster in {example} (a year, e.g. 2019).

under_posters.sentence_year_show.value: Shows the year it first aired, like {example}.
under_posters.sentence_year_show.description: Sentence beside the Year row of the TV show details picker while it has focus: what the part shows, with the real example from the preview poster in {example} (a year, e.g. 2019).

under_posters.sentence_length.description: Sentence beside the Length row of the Movie details picker while it has focus: the running time, with the preview poster's own in {example} (e.g. 2h 14m; keep each language's duration spelling).

under_posters.sentence_seasons.value: Shows how many seasons it has, like {example}.
under_posters.sentence_seasons.description: Sentence beside the Seasons row of the TV show details picker while it has focus: the season count, with the preview poster's own in {example} (e.g. 6 seasons).

under_posters.sentence_genre.description: Sentence beside the Genre row of a details picker while it has focus: the genre, with the preview poster's own in {example} (e.g. Drama).

under_posters.sentence_video.description: Sentence beside the Video quality row of the Movie details picker while it has focus: the video marks, with the preview poster's own in {example} (e.g. 4K · HDR).

under_posters.sentence_age_rating.description: Sentence beside the Age rating row of a details picker while it has focus: the rating, with the preview poster's own in {example} (e.g. PG-13).

under_posters.sentence_score.description: Sentence beside the Score row of a details picker while it has focus: the audience score, with the preview poster's own in {example} (e.g. 7.8).

under_posters.picker_header.description: Section heading over the rows of a details picker on the Under posters page (drawn in capitals): the list of parts that can be shown under a poster. Short.
